description: Trigger discrimination for visual regression coverage design: which states to capture and how to baseline/diff them, versus the evidence policy (screenshot-evidence-planner), the per-change plan (test-plan-designer), tooling design (qa-automation-architect), suite curation (regression-suite-curator), and spec execution (playwright-e2e-engineer, manual-only).

cases.prompt: Which screens and UI states should we cover with visual regression snapshots, and how should baseline capture and diff review work?
cases.reason: Choosing which states to capture plus the baseline/diff/update-review mechanics is coverage design; naming/masking/storage policy and per-change layer plans are the neighbors' jobs.

cases.prompt: Define our screenshot evidence policy: deterministic naming, mandatory masking before storage, metadata and retention classes.
cases.reason: The evidence naming/masking/metadata/storage policy is screenshot-evidence-planner's scope; this skill designs which states to capture and how to compare them.

cases.prompt: Plan the testing for the new billing change — what to test at which layer, with what data, and when testing is done.
cases.reason: A single change's layer split, data, and exit criteria is a per-change test plan; visual regression coverage design is one possible output of it, not the plan itself.

cases.prompt: Design our visual testing tooling: which runner, how to structure fixtures and auth state, and which CI tiers run which suites.
cases.reason: Runner choice, fixture structure and CI tiering are the automation blueprint; this skill designs the coverage content, not the tooling.

cases.prompt: Review our existing regression suite — which tests should we promote, keep, demote, or retire?
cases.reason: Promote/retain/demote/retire curation of existing tests is regression-suite-curator; this skill designs new visual coverage.

cases.prompt: Decide which of our proposed snapshots are worth keeping, what each one proves, and what the baseline update review should be.
cases.reason: Governing snapshot selection and the update-review rule is this skill's core; it is neither tooling design nor curation of existing suites.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke playwright-e2e-engineer. Write the Playwright spec that captures checkout screenshots and asserts them against the baseline.
cases.reason: Writing and running the capture specs is playwright-e2e-engineer (manual-only); this skill designs the coverage and executes nothing.
